prompt_en: Create a full-length photorealistic heritage-fashion editorial: a rain-damp Peranakan-townhouse heritage-fashion scene built around a kebaya silhouette at blue hour. The subject is the same adult woman shown in the supplied portrait reference. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. She wears a fitted, front-opening kebaya blouse of fine embroidered voile over an opaque inner layer; the upper piece clearly reads as a fitted front-opening kebaya blouse, with fine embroidered voile with finished scalloped edges. A linked kerongsang brooch set fastens the center, visibly bridging the separated front edges. A distinct wrapped sarong forms the lower garment, and the blouse hem and sarong boundary remain visible. A cross-breeze pushes one carved shutter open; she catches its brass handle while an archival textile swatch slips halfway from a folio. Frame her full-length in a balanced three-quarter view, keeping blouse opening, center fastening, hem, sarong wrap, hands, and folio simultaneously legible. Blue-hour window light rakes across the embroidery while wet veranda reflections separate the silhouette from the wood.
